rules.cache: Each block/condition isolated; source memory and result memory empty initially. Only prior successful same-condition source changes may be recorded. Exact task, all workspace files/modes and external context must match. No historical solutions.
rules.limits: Sol high requested priority, readable source-memory display, legacy lexical ranking. Fresh model state per call; persistent isolated memory per block/condition. 900 seconds,20 steps,1000000 token threshold. No retry, replacement, extension, pooling, heldout exposure or implementation tuning during run.
rules.scope: Development ablation on previously exposed Click tasks: plain result replay versus CAMI plus result replay. Two tasks and exact repeats, not heldout evidence, production hit rate or billed currency.
rules.success: All40 operational/quality attempts and telemetry complete;20 changed-input rejection probes with successful unchanged-input controls; uniform observed tier on20 model sessions;20 expected hits without model. Plain+replay strictly lower four-stage token work AND pipeline wall than CAMI+replay in EACH of5 paired blocks. Otherwise unsupported. No retry, replacement, extension or pooling.
rules.wall: Includes canonical reset, independent source-memory construction, guards, model/auth/cleanup, cache lookup/record/materialization, capture and fresh grading. Shared fixed-baseline preflight divided equally across10 block-condition sequences. Interleaved order; host load recorded, not a guarantee of independent host quietness.
